<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Flirting|id=A0127}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Liliana and JP talk about flirting in Latin America and Liliana demonstrates her most powerful weapons. As flirting requires continuous action, this is also the perfect opportunity to introduce the gerund, also known as the ing-form. The keyword is: '''coquetear''' – to flirt.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0001|A0001: Are you ready yet?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0002|A0002: Birthday party]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0086|A0086: Are you single?]]}}
<noinclude>{{SbcAudioLojbanPod|title=Flirting|id=A0127|dialogueid=A0127 dialogue}}</noinclude>

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Mírala! Está coqueteando.'''
| Look at her! She is flirting.
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| Why?
| '''Te ve y te sonríe.'''
| She looks at you and she smiles.
| '''¡Perfecto! Voy a hablar con ella.'''
| Perfect! I'm going to talk with her.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Mírala! Está coqueteando.'''
| Look at her! She is flirting.
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| Why?
| '''Te ve y te sonríe.'''
| She looks at you and she smiles.
| '''¡Perfecto! Voy a hablar con ella.'''
| Perfect! I'm going to talk with her.
}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Look at her! She smiles at you.
| '''¡Mírala! Te sonríe.''' 
| Why?
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| She looks at you and she smiles at you.
| '''Te ve y te sonríe.'''
| So what? ({{=}} and what?)
| '''¿Y qué?'''
| ¡She is flirting!
| '''¡Está coqueteando!'''
| Perfect! I'm going to talk with her.
| '''¡Perfecto! Voy a hablar con ella.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Look at her! She smiles at you.
| '''¡Mírala! Te sonríe.''' 
| Why?
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| She looks at you and she smiles at you.
| '''Te ve y te sonríe.'''
| So what? ({{=}} and what?)
| '''¿Y qué?'''
| ¡She is flirting!
| '''¡Está coqueteando!'''
| Perfect! I'm going to talk with her.
| '''¡Perfecto! Voy a hablar con ella.'''
}}</includeonly>
